title: A Dream of John Ball; and, A King's Lesson
sourceTitle: A Dream of John Ball; and, A King's Lesson
author: William Morris
description: "A Dream of John Ball; and, A King's Lesson" by William Morris is a novel published in 1888.
longDescription: It tells the story of a time-traveller who meets the medieval rebel priest John Ball during the Great Revolt of 1381. Through their encounter, Morris contrasts the ethics of medieval and modern worlds, exploring why Ball's dreams of an egalitarian society remain unfulfilled centuries later.

authorInfo.bio: William Morris was an English textile designer, poet, artist, writer, and socialist activist associated with the British Arts and Crafts movement. He was a major contributor to the revival of traditional British textile arts and methods of production. His literary contributions helped to establish the modern fantasy genre, while he campaigned for socialism in fin de siècle Great Britain.
